name: SYNAPSE SLAM CONTINENTAL: Neural-Physical Open S3
description: The Synapse Slam Continental is the flagship hybrid competition in which athletes compete simultaneously in physical obstacle courses and neural puzzle architectures broadcast directly to their BCIs — solving logic cascades while climbing, sprinting, or absorbing contact impacts. Cognitive errors trigger physical penalties; physical failures corrupt the neural track. Governed by the Neural-Physical Athletic Accord, a body jointly administered by HelixCorp and Axiom Workforce Solutions, the league draws elite competitors from all augmentation backgrounds, though BCI-enhanced athletes dominate the upper brackets.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 athlete with a black-market BCI — not officially registered — qualifies for the Open through a regional qualifier under a false augmentation certificate, and must compete while hiding the illegal hardware from league scanners.

A retired Synapse Slam champion is approached by a journalist who has obtained internal HelixCorp documents suggesting the cascade failures in Season 2 were predictable and predicted — and suppressed.

A competitor discovers mid-tournament that the neural puzzle architecture she's been solving contains actual proprietary data that someone has embedded in the competition layer — and that solving it correctly means transmitting it somewhere she doesn't control.
